# OSpacing

The goal of OSpacing is to evaluate systems reliability by the order statistics representation, combining with the survival signature.

## Installation

You can install the development version of OSpacing like so:

```{r}
devtools::install_github("leijingzhe/OSpacing")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(OSpacing)
square(6)
```
